# Benjamin Franz Nößler

> Fullstack software developer based in Vienna, Austria. Developer since an IT apprenticeship in 2017: Java with Spring Boot and Hibernate on the back end, TypeScript with Angular and React on the front end, plus mobile apps with Ionic and Capacitor. Since May 2026: an own system of AI agents based on Claude and OpenClaw, and agentic development with Claude Code.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, TypeScript, Angular, React, Next.js, Astro, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Linux, Docker, Coolify.

Working languages: German (native), English.
